Maintain fall precautions and bed rest with assistance for mobility given bedfast status and altered mental status.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin.
Continue frequent neurologic and delirium monitoring (CAM-ICU, GCS, RASS) given fluctuating orientation and agitation.
